summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a Monthly Return of Equity Issuer on Movements in Securities for April 2026, submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The filing reports no change in authorized share capital (10 billion shares at $0.00001 par value) and no movement in issued shares (1,238,960,393 ordinary shares outstanding, no treasury shares). It includes a standard confirmation of public float sufficiency and details outstanding share options under the 2020 Share Incentive Plan. This is a routine regulatory disclosure with no special-situation event.
